To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) we developed a MATLAB-based GUI tool to convert ECG waveforms from paper-based ECG records into digital ECG signals that are vendor agnostic; 2) the digitization results are comparable to paper-based ECG waveforms; and 3) the tool can be used to digitize paper-based ECGs and to interface patients' demographic information to their research records or EMR.
we have created a MATLAB based open source tool to convert electro cardiography (ECG).
the proposed MATLAB based digitization tool is capable of preserving clinically important features of ECG waveforms.

developing a tool to digitize paper based ECGs and thereby enable development of new algorithms to improve the risk stratification of cardiovascular patients.
